items.title: 52043_Herman Autrey oral history interview
items.q: playing with Fats Waller, Bessie Smith, and Bunny Berrigan

ctx.x: Oh, man, 'cause I drink, I must eat. So that was the greatest thing I -- to my mind -- that I had ever done, is playing with Fats Waller, Bessie Smith, and Bunny Berrigan.
